limitations: Saved-video simulations do not prove semantic or subjective listening quality.
The real duration prediction set has only 28 Kim Thanh takes. Its sequential MAE is a bounded diagnostic, not a blind multi-voice benchmark.
The automatic real-source comparison uses identical audio and has only a small tail/lag difference; no perceptible improvement is claimed.
Live voiceInAd includes one sample 2 ms after ad onset, within the existing 50 ms tick and fade transition. No sustained ad speech was observed.
P95 is measured per video; the sum of P95 values is not corpus P95. Playback-rate jumps are not a subjective heard-pace score.
Small per-video regressions remain, quantified and accepted in the corpus report; no causal ablation was used to assign each local delta to a particular component.
